prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. PRODUCTION REFERENCE SHEET, landscape, not a finished book page. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
WD-KIT / Kit: six-year-old human boy, golden light-medium skin, short straight black side-parted hair, teal T-shirt, mustard shorts, navy sneakers. The ONLY named human protagonist is Kit. Zoe MUST NOT appear. Ignore every other child shown in reference sheets; unnamed adults may appear only when this scene explicitly requires them. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: Before the Market Opens; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: One illustrative local farmers market and nearby carrot farm. Grower sells her own crop directly. Grower: brown skin, dark braid, rust-colored work shirt and navy trousers. Market worker: light-medium skin, short gray hair, teal vest. Kit’s accompanying adult: deep brown skin, short black hair, plain cream shirt and dark trousers. No named brands, prices, logos or cultural markers.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): One green wooden produce crate with a pale diagonal brace on one side; Fresh carrots with green tops; One plain gray van; One simple wooden stall table; One cloth shopping bag carried by Kit’s adult
 Create a clean separated reference board on white: show the principal recurring props/animals in front, side and three-quarter views, their relative scale beside any named human cast, and a single simple location key showing the persistent setting and daylight/palette. The human character model sheet is a supporting identity reference, not content to copy wholesale. Show only the subjects this book requires. Use initial object states: Opening view is earlier than customer arrival; grower and green crate are still at the farm.. For orientation, the opening location/action is: Early-morning market space: one empty wooden table occupies the foreground while the worker opens the gate. No carrot stock has arrived at this stall. Continuity: Opening view is earlier than customer arrival; grower and green crate are still at the farm.. Do not show a completed craft or later scene merely because the finished object is listed in design locks. No future story events, no captions.
Design board consistency: clean flat 2D and human child/adult body proportions, correct normal furniture geometry, no impossible perspective or room-sized shelf. All ordinary physical props clean unlettered designs. Reference board is production design only; not final page panels.
Include all necessary adult designs as stated, clearly different three adults, and Kit only child. NO Zoe. Distinctive one green crate with pale diagonal brace visible from front/side; gray van plausible doors/wheels/cargo bay; normal single wooden market table, gate, carrot bunches. Avoid huge props or nonsensical nested furniture.

visualReview.note: Direct native and installed WebP reference: Kit plus three distinct adults, single braced green crate design, ordinary gray van and market table/cloth bag; no Zoe.
visualReview.limits: Direct agent image/sequence inspection; not physical classroom observation.
